question: Which pair won the gold in the Men’s Doubles SL3–SL4 at the 2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship?

options.text: Sukant Kadam and Umesh Vikram Kumar

solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitesh Kumar and Sukant Kadam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian pair of **Nitesh Kumar** and **Sukant Kadam** secured the **Gold Medal** in the **Men’s Doubles SL3–SL4** category at the **2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship**.
 
• This victory highlights **India's** continued dominance in the para-badminton circuit, particularly in the **SL (Standing Lower)** classifications.
 
• **Nitesh Kumar**, who is a celebrated **Paralympic Gold Medalist**, paired effectively with the seasoned shuttler **Sukant Kadam** to overcome their competitors in the final match of the tournament.
 
• The **2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship** serves as a crucial ranking event for para-athletes, contributing points toward international standings governed by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**.
 
• The win reinforces the strength of the Indian para-badminton contingent, which has been consistently producing world-class athletes under the guidance of the **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)** and the **Badminton Association of India (BAI)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classification SL3**: This category is designated for players with impairment in one or both lower limbs and poor walking or running balance. To reduce the physical demand, **SL3** matches are played on a **half-court**.
 
• **Classification SL4**: Players in this category have a lower limb impairment but possess better balance and movement compared to those in **SL3**. They compete on a **full court**.
 
• **Nitesh Kumar**: He is one of India's most prominent para-athletes, having won the **Gold Medal** in the **Men’s Singles SL3** event at the **2024 Paris Paralympics**. He hails from **Haryana** and is known for his tactical brilliance on the court.
 
• **Sukant Kadam**: Based in **Maharashtra**, Sukant Kadam is a world-class athlete in the **SL4** category. He has multiple medals to his name from the **BWF Para-Badminton World Championships** and the **Asian Para Games**.
 
• **Asia Para Badminton Championship**: This is a premier **continental tournament** held to determine the best para-badminton players in **Asia**. It features various categories including **WH1-WH2 (Wheelchair)**, **SL3**, **SL4**, **SU5**, and **SH6 (Short Stature)**.
 
• **Recent Achievements**: India has emerged as a powerhouse in para-badminton, with athletes like **Pramod Bhagat**, **Krishna Nagar**, and **Manasi Joshi** bringing international laurels to the country in recent **years**.
